← PrivyPDF tools

Tool limitations

ToolCurrent boundary
Office conversionsText-oriented, not layout-preserving. PDF → Word uses an HTML .doc wrapper; PDF → Excel exports CSV with spreadsheet-triggering values prefixed as text.
CompressionRasterizes pages; text selection, forms and accessibility information are lost. Target size is best effort.
OCREnglish only; recognition needs review. Invisible text is not precisely positioned. OCR language models may be downloaded from the Tesseract model host.
SignatureTyped visual mark, not certificate-based signing or verified identity.
EditorAdds text overlays, not editing existing PDF text. Standard fonts have limited language coverage.
ScannerPhoto capture/import and near-white trimming; no perspective correction.
Privacy InspectorRead-only structural checks, not a security audit or secure-erasure guarantee. Sanitized sharing downloads are disabled pending verification.
Clear info fieldsClears selected standard document-info fields only. It is not hidden-data removal.
SanitizationVerified secure sanitization is unavailable and produces no PDF download.
RedactionExperimental raster output; page and region are validated before download. Verify visual result and extracted text independently.
Header removalWhite overlays leave text recoverable. Not redaction.
Ask PDF / summaryKeyword retrieval / sentence ranking, not generative AI.
RepairResaves parseable files; not damaged-file recovery.
TranslationBrowser-dependent Translator API; English source and TXT output. Browser-managed language models may be downloaded or used.
File limits100 MB per file beta processing limit; device memory can impose lower limits.

Changes may invalidate digital signatures. Keep originals. Cancellation reloads the tab and clears selected files; it is not resumable.
